Title: Antec TruePower Classic 550W Power Supply Unit Review
URL: https://www.nikktech.com/main/articles/pc-hardware/power-supplies/3370-antec-truepower-classic-550w-power-supply-unit-review?showall=1
Published: 2014-04-17T21:10:36.000Z
Author: Nik Kastrantas
Highlights:
## Antec TruePower Classic 550W Power Supply Unit Review 

 Details 
: Published: 17 April 2014

...

550W may seem too little of a output for some consumers but its more than just enough to power entry/mid-end systems especially since in this case we are also talking about an 80 Plus Gold certified unit that features two +12v high current rails able to output 95% of the units total wattage, PhaseWave industrial design, Japanese capacitors, industrial grade protection set (Over Current/Over Voltage/Under Voltage/Short Circuit/Over Power/Over Temperature/Surge & Inrush/No Load Operation) and ErP Lot 6 support. Of course the TruePower Classic line includes 3 other models (450/650/50W) all of which are covered by Antec’s lifetime global 24/7 support and 5 years warranty. So the time has come for us to see just how the 550W model compares to its slightly larger brother that passed from our test bench a while back.

SPECIFICATIONS AND FEATURES

PACKAGING AND CONTENTS

The TruePower Classic 550W arrived inside a box with a large product image at the front right next to its main features, power output and the 5 years warranty and Antec logos.

Just like with the 650W model the 80 Plus Gold certification, 5 years warranty and ATX v2.4 features are printed at the top of the box.

 The units’ electrical table and available power connectors are placed on the right side while on the left we see the features list in 4 languages.

Antec has also placed the same features list at the rear in 8 languages.

The TP-550C is placed between two cardboard spacers.

Along with the TP-550C PSU you will also get 4 mounting screws, AC power cable, product overview paper and a warranty paper.

THE TRUEPOWER CLASSIC 550W EXTERIOR

Unfortunately once again the model in our hands is not modular although it would make little sense for a 550W PSU to be modular (too few power connectors).

Antec has again made use of a 120mm intake fan.

The model name and its max continuous output are printed on both sides.

A large sticker at the top of the unit contains its electrical specifications table and many certification icons.

...

Here we see the same 120mm dual ball bearing brushless fan manufactured by JAMICON Electronics (2200RPM/81.17CFM/36.8dBA) as we did with the 650W model.

The interior layout is also identical as the 650W model so there's no doubt that Seasonic is also behind the new TP-550C.

The primary capacitor used is manufactured by United Chemi-Con and is certified for use up to 105 Celsius.

...

Although our average power draw was between 520W and 570W most of the time the rails are quite tight.

POWER CONSUMPTION

Again our test system managed to squeeze up to 617W even if just instantly.

...

When we test two models of the same product line we more or less know what to expect but because of our test rig configuration the TP-550C actually impressed us more than its larger brother the TP-650C since it allowed us even instantly to draw 617W from it. Things get even better since during our load tests we used anything between 520W and 570W without any issues at all and although i don't recommend that for long periods of time still we didn't expect a model like the TP-550C to pass our tests with flying colors (not with the wattage required). On top of that add the solid rails and the fact that the 120mm fan never went over 47dBA and the TruePower Classic 550W is certainly not your average every day PSU.

---

## Description for Antec 550W Watt Power supply | TP-550C EC

P-550C The gold standard of power Antec’s TruePower Classic series sets new standards for power supplies. TruePower Classic is one of the first series to comply with the toughest energy standard available, ErP Lot 6: 2013. By using a PSU that is 80 PLUS® GOLD certified, operating up to 92% efficient, you can reduce your electricity bill by up to 20% when compared to many other power supplies. 2 High Current Rails and a 99% +12V output ratio maximize TP-550C’s capabilities to power the latest CPU’s & GPU’s. TP Classic’s PhaseWave™ Design is a server-class LLC design with a synchronous rectification based on a DC-DC topology. Japanese capacitors achieve unprecedented tight voltage regulation & low ripple & noise to maximize your system’s performance. Antec’s intelligent Thermal Manager fan control spins the high-quality 12cm DBB fan optimally to cool your PSU quietly. CircuitShield™ makes the TP-550C safe and reliable in any environment with its eight industrial-grade protections. Backed by a 5 year warranty and lifetime global 24/7 support, the TP-550C is the guaranteed gold standard for power.
